name: Entity Weight Views
description: Adds a reorder contextual link to selected views, allowing editors to reorder only the entities displayed in that specific view.
project_description: Entity Weight Views is the submodule of Entity Weight that adds an independent, per-view-display ordering for the entities a specific Views display shows. Selected view displays gain a 'Reorder view' contextual link (and an optional Views area button); editors reorder the full result set of that display with drag-and-drop, and the order is stored in a dedicated entity_weight_views_order table keyed by view id, display id, entity id and langcode - separate from the global entity weight field. The order is injected into the view query at highest priority via hook_views_query_alter using COALESCE(language weight, shared weight, 0), so multilingual sites keep one shared order by default and can opt a language into its own order. It depends on the entity_weight, views and contextual modules and reuses the parent module's 'assign entity weight' permission.
